item.title: Hardware UART Monitor: Snooping Serial Traffic with MSP430 LaunchPad
item.description: Related series articles: Why You Should Avoid the SIM900A GSM Module Connecting MSP430 to SIM900A When using UART, for debugging purposes, I needed to monitor what the MSP430 was sending and what the second device (SIM900) was responding with. For this, you need to remove the MCU from the LaunchPad and connect it independently (for example, on a breadboard). And connect the LaunchPad itself to the computer to monitor the UART.
